## Dough Intent Coverage Report

- **Verdict:** **Caught** (bounded to the observed `"Ready for review"` / `activity === "review"` submit-and-close path when the session remains ready into attach disconnect in `e2e/terminals/agent-terminal-submit-and-close.spec.ts`, lines 188–229; `"awaiting-instruction"` and `"waiting"` activity variants were not exercised).
- **Next proof action:** No test repair is required to catch premature close before leave-ready across the scenario as a whole, because the disconnect-before-leave-ready leg catches it. Note that the earlier happy-path leave-ready leg (`e2e/terminals/agent-terminal-submit-and-close.spec.ts`, lines 140–186) immediately calls `dashboard.claudeSessionBecomes(scene.session.id, "working")` after `Command+Enter` without first checking that the terminal remained open while still ready; deciding whether that earlier step should also assert `scene.terminal.expectShown()` before leaving ready stays with the caller.
- **Prior disposition and planned repair check:** `.planning/seeds/SEED-398-deferred-submit-and-close-follow-ups.md` (`SEED-398#deferred-submit-and-close-follow-ups`) records a deferred product follow-up from `SEED-385` considering `"send Enter and Close immediately"` as an alternate or primary close timing. That is a deferred product-behavior option rather than an already-planned test repair; `SEED-411` explicitly preserves current wait-for-leave-ready behavior, and no already-planned test repair was found for this check.

### Target and Probe Details

- **Story and revision:** `SEED-411#express-submit-and-close-test-intent` (`.planning/seeds/SEED-411-express-submit-and-close-test-intent.md`) at `a6164fa66da2be009f7c22e365364ccf6050bf6f` (which contains the `SEED-411` page-object rewrite `f0ead22572ab0198b41edc9daf4ff0405a65a32e`, integrated at `158effe395b21f8596dfee62a1e5204a4e770825`).
- **Selected promise:** *"Preserve distinct behavior: ready Command+Enter submits one Enter and closes after leave-ready; disconnect without leave-ready keeps the panel and names confirmation unavailable; a working session or unfocused input does not submit-and-close; plain Enter still submits without closing."* Specifically probed: `Command+Enter` on a focused ready terminal waits for activity to leave ready before closing rather than closing while still ready.
- **Fault location and change:** `dashboard/src/submitAndCloseTerminal.ts`, `leftReady` (lines 33–35), temporarily changing `return activity === "working" || activity === "waiting";` to `return activity !== undefined;` (narrowed within the suggested `useSubmitAndCloseTerminal.ts` / `submitAndCloseTerminal.ts` fault area so `readyForPrompt` still blocks the earlier working-session `Command+Enter` step and TypeScript unused-binding checks stay clean, isolating premature close while `activity === "review"`). Fixtures and assertions were left intact.
- **Fixtures used:** `publishStoryColumnsJourney` (`dashboard/test-support/launchJourney.ts`), `dashboard` fixture with synthetic `claude` (`e2e/terminals/fixtures/fake-claude`, `claudeScenario("launched")`, `claudeSessionBecomes(..., "done-live" | "working")`), `openStoryColumnsBoard` (`dashboard/test-support/storyColumnsBoard.ts`), and `terminalScreen` (`dashboard/test-support/terminalScreen.ts`).
- **Maintained check and catching assertion:** Command `caffeinate -s -i npx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/terminals/agent-terminal-submit-and-close.spec.ts`, exercising `e2e/terminals/agent-terminal-submit-and-close.spec.ts` line 57 (`Command+Enter submit and close › ready Command+Enter submits one line and closes after leave-ready; disconnect without leave-ready keeps confirmation unavailable; working and plain Enter stay open`). Caught at `e2e/terminals/agent-terminal-submit-and-close.spec.ts` line 226 (`await scene.terminal.expectStatus(confirmationUnavailable)` in step `"Then the terminal stays open and confirmation is unavailable"`), delegated to `SessionTerminalScreen.expectStatus` at `dashboard/test-support/terminalScreen.ts` line 222 (`await expect(this.#status).toContainText(text)` on `getByRole('region', { name: 'Terminal', exact: true }).getByRole('status')`).

### Run Observations

- **Pre-probe state and baseline:** Created detached scratch worktree `/tmp/dough-ic-seed-411-681ee287` at `a6164fa66da2be009f7c22e365364ccf6050bf6f`, verified empty `git status --short --untracked-files=all`, and symlinked `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/node_modules`. An initial cold baseline run exited `0` (`20,396 ms` shell wall time); a baseline run with `OPEN_DOUGH_E2E_PROOF_RECORD` confirmed `selectedCount: 1` exercised and passed (`runnerStatus: "passed"`, runner duration `11,580.19 ms`, test attempt `4,469 ms`).
- **Fault reach and wrong-behavior verification:** Under the `leftReady` fault, the focused run failed (`selectedCount: 1`, `runnerStatus: "failed"`, runner duration `20,832.60 ms`, test attempt `10,480 ms`). Earlier steps all passed, proving reach: working-session `Command+Enter` (lines 100–121), plain `Enter` (lines 123–133), first ready `Command+Enter` `"follow up"` (lines 135–186, which passed because line 148 immediately sets `"working"`), reopen (lines 188–199), and second ready `Command+Enter` `"retry later"` (lines 201–215, polling `lines.includes("retry later") === true` at line 207). Playwright's retained failure ARIA snapshot (`error-context.md`) independently confirms wrong product behavior on the intended path: `Story B`'s `Execution session` still read `"Ready for review"` with `button "Open terminal"` shown on the card while `region "Terminal"` was already absent (`Error: element(s) not found` after `5000 ms` waiting for `getByRole('region', { name: 'Terminal', exact: true }).getByRole('status')` at `terminalScreen.ts:222`), proving the panel closed while still ready rather than staying open before leave-ready.
- **Restoration and cleanup:** Restored `dashboard/src/submitAndCloseTerminal.ts`, removed the failed run's `e2e/test-results` directory, verified `git diff --exit-code` (`0`), and reran the same focused command with `OPEN_DOUGH_E2E_PROOF_RECORD` (`selectedCount: 1`, `runnerStatus: "passed"`, runner duration `11,956.15 ms`, test attempt `4,636 ms`). Removed the temporary `node_modules` symlink, verified empty `git status --short --untracked-files=all` at `a6164fa66da2be009f7c22e365364ccf6050bf6f`, removed the temporary worktree and proof records, and verified `git worktree list` and `git status --short` in `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough` remained clean.
